jei.neosync.info.sync_core: The core part of every shell block.
jei.neosync.info.shell_constructor: Right-click with an empty hand to give a sample and start growing a shell. The sample costs eight hearts. Needs power: a Treadmill or any power cable.
jei.neosync.info.shell_storage: Keeps a shell alive on redstone or power. Walk in while the doors are open to switch bodies. Sneak and right-click with a dye to color it.
jei.neosync.info.manual_shell_storage: A Shell Storage you're never moved into automatically when you die.
jei.neosync.info.treadmill: Lure an animal onto the front block and it makes power for anything touching the Treadmill. Ants are the best at it by a mile. Also sold on Antazon.
jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_constr: Builds shells instantly with no power. The sample still costs eight hearts.
jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_storag: Needs no power, opens as you walk up, and the shell inside never decays.
